```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(ggdist)
library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(tidybayes)
library(cowplot)
library(gganimate)

# OPTIMIZE PERFORMANCE 
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(), brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
cache_dir <- here::here("local_temp_data", "simulation_test")
if(!dir.exists(cache_dir)) {
    dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

source(here::here("R/utils", "simulate_data.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "sampling_parallel.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "brm_parallel.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils", "cluster.R")) 
source(here::here("R/utils", "pp_checks.R"))

#LOAD DATA
proact <- read_csv(here::here("private_data/F_PROACT_ALSFRS.csv"))
```

No `brm_parallel` / `setup_cluster` here on purpose: this is a handful
of diagnostic fits, so plain `brm()` with `file=` caching is simpler and
avoids the shared-memory problems of the parallel path.

## Data preparation

```{r}
# DATA PREPARATION
# unify Q5
# omit vars that are not useful
# unify question names
# keep only complete obs

days_per_month <- 365.25 / 12

any(!is.na(proact$Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy) & !is.na(proact$Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy) &
        proact$Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy != proact$Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy)
#TODO: need to resolve this

proact_full <- proact %>% 
    mutate(Q5_Cutting_Combined = if_else(is.na(Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy), 
                                         Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy, Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy)) %>%
    select(-Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy, -Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy, 
           -Q10_Respiratory, -ALSFRS_Total, -Mode_of_Administration, -ALSFRS_Responded_By) %>%
    filter(if_all(c(starts_with("Q"), starts_with("R")), function(x) { !is.na(x) } )) 


question_col_names_proact <- sort(names(proact_full)[grepl("^[QR]", names(proact_full))])
question_col_names <- sprintf("Q%02d", 1:12)
question_col_names_translation <- sprintf("Q%02d", 1:12)
names(question_col_names_translation) <- question_col_names_proact

proact_standardized <- proact_full %>%
    rename_with(function(x) { question_col_names_translation[x]}, .cols = all_of(question_col_names_proact)) %>%
    rename(alsfrs_total = ALSFRS_R_Total) %>%
    mutate(alsfrs_dly_mnths = ALSFRS_Delta / days_per_month) %>%
    select(subject_id, all_of(question_col_names), alsfrs_total, alsfrs_dly_mnths) 


proact_standardized
```

## Simulate data

```{r}
set.seed(20260727)

n_rep <- 5     
n_subjects_per_group <- 100
max_duration <- 12

scenarios <- tidyr::crossing(eff_prob = c(0.5, 0.8), rep = seq_len(n_rep))

sims <- pmap(scenarios, function(eff_prob, rep) {
    simulate_data_from_registry(proact_standardized,
                                max_duration = max_duration,
                                min_measurements_per_subject = 4,
                                max_measurements_per_subject = 8,
                                n_subjects_per_group = n_subjects_per_group,
                                effect_prob = eff_prob)
})

# SHIFT SCORES 0-4 -> 1-5 FOR THE ORDINAL LIKELIHOOD
sims <- map(sims, ~ .x %>% mutate(across(all_of(question_col_names), \(x) x + 1)))

```

# Baseline model - One question

```{r}
# CHECK THE SCORE DISTRIBUTION - pick a question that actually uses its range
question_to_fit <- "Q05"

map_dfr(sims, ~ as.list(table(factor(.x[[question_to_fit]], levels = 1:5))),
        .id = "sim") %>%
    bind_cols(scenarios) %>%
    select(eff_prob, rep, `1`:`5`)
```

```{r}
f_base <- as.formula(paste0(
    question_to_fit,
    " ~ 1 + s(alsfrs_dly_mnths, by = group) + (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths | subject_id)"))

fit_base <- brm(
    f_base,
    family = cumulative("logit"),
    data = sims[[1]],
    adapt_delta = 0.95, init = 0.1,
    chains = 4, iter = 3000, warmup = 1000,
    file = file.path(cache_dir, "base_null_rep1"), file_refit = "on_change")

fit_base
```

## Randomized quantile residuals

### Fit_base

```{r}
res_plot_base <- sims[[1]] %>%
    add_predicted_draws(fit_base) %>%
    mutate(.prediction = as.integer(as.character(.prediction)))  %>%
    summarise(
        p_lower = mean(.prediction < Q05),
        p_upper = mean(.prediction <= Q05),
        p_residual = runif(1, p_lower, p_upper),
        z_residual = qnorm(p_residual),
        .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = alsfrs_dly_mnths, y = z_residual)) +
    geom_point()

res_plot_base
```

```{r}
res_qq_base <- sims[[1]] %>%
    add_predicted_draws(fit_base) %>%
    mutate(.prediction = as.integer(as.character(.prediction)))  %>%
    summarise(
        p_lower = mean(.prediction < Q05),
        p_upper = mean(.prediction <= Q05),
        p_residual = runif(1, p_lower, p_upper),
        z_residual = qnorm(p_residual),
        .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(sample = z_residual)) +
    geom_qq() +
    geom_abline()

res_qq_base
```

### Fit_disc

```{r}
prior_disc <- c(prior(constant(0),  class = "Intercept", dpar = "disc"),
                prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b",         dpar = "disc"))

fit_disc_time <- brm(
    bf(f_base, disc ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths),
    family = cumulative("logit", link_disc = "log"),
    data = sims[[1]], prior = prior_disc,
    adapt_delta = 0.95, init = 0.1,
    chains = 4, iter = 3000, warmup = 1000,
    file = file.path(cache_dir, "disc_time_null_rep1"), file_refit = "on_change")
```

```{r}
res_plot_disc <- sims[[1]] %>%
    add_predicted_draws(fit_disc_time) %>%
    mutate(.prediction = as.integer(as.character(.prediction)))  %>%
    summarise(
        p_lower = mean(.prediction < Q05),
        p_upper = mean(.prediction <= Q05),
        p_residual = runif(1, p_lower, p_upper),
        z_residual = qnorm(p_residual),
        .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = alsfrs_dly_mnths, y = z_residual)) +
    geom_point()

res_plot_disc
```

```{r}
res_qq_disc <- sims[[1]] %>%

    mutate(.prediction = as.integer(as.character(.prediction)))  %>%
    summarise(
        p_lower = mean(.prediction < Q05),
        p_upper = mean(.prediction <= Q05),

        .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%

res_qq_disc
```

# All questions

```{r}
questions_to_fit <- question_col_names[] 

f_all <- as.formula(paste0(
    "mvbind(", paste0(questions_to_fit, collapse = ", "),
    ") ~ 1 + s(alsfrs_dly_mnths, by = group) + (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths | p | subject_id)"
))

fit_all <- brm(
    f_all,
    family = cumulative("logit"),
    data = sims[[1]],
    adapt_delta = 0.95, init = 0.1,
    chains = 4, iter = 3000, warmup = 1000,
    file = file.path(cache_dir, "base_null_rep1"), file_refit = "on_change")

fit_all
```

```{r}
obs_long <- sims[[1]] %>%
    mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
    select(.row, alsfrs_dly_mnths, group, all_of(question_col_names), subject_id) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(question_col_names),
                        names_to = ".category", values_to = "y_obs") 

resid_draws <- sims[[1]] %>%
    select(all_of(question_col_names), alsfrs_dly_mnths, group, subject_id) %>%
    add_predicted_draws(fit_all, ndraws = 100, seed = 468652233) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(.prediction = as.integer(as.character(.prediction)),
           .category   = as.character(.category)) %>%
    select(.row, .draw, .category, .prediction) %>%
    left_join(obs_long, by = c(".row", ".category")) %>%
    group_by(.row, .category, alsfrs_dly_mnths, group) %>%
    summarise(
        p_lower = mean(.prediction <  y_obs),
        p_upper = mean(.prediction <= y_obs),
        p_residual = runif(1, p_lower, p_upper),
        z_residual = qnorm(p_residual),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

res_plot_all <- resid_draws %>%
    ggplot(aes(alsfrs_dly_mnths, z_residual)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ .category)

res_plot_all


res_qq_all <- resid_draws %>%
    ggplot(aes(sample = z_residual)) +
    geom_qq() +
    geom_abline() +
    facet_wrap(~ .category)

res_qq_all




```
